method: Mocks served from the uploaded look pack. Each open UI head served by Vite. Chrome, deviceScaleFactor 2, America/New_York, Figtree and JetBrains Mono loaded (document.fonts.check). Viewports 1280×800 and 1440×900. Mock clock is window.__cap.step. Shell clock is window.__shellCap.step. App card rise used Playwright's clock at 16.667ms; that clock repeated CSS animation samples, so durations for the rise are taken from source and from the mock frames, not from the stalled app curve.

scores.note: Page x/y and content height excluded. Pen stroke 2.33 vs 1.75 is a DEVIATION by rule (DASDEVBOT-LOOK.md:58), still counted as a raw miss.
Same chrome misses as main. #21 adds --ink-press, which this resting sample does not include.
Glass matches on the lit shot. The approval shot's composer is paper until hover.
Window box matched 30/30. Composer element is transparent; the visible mat is paper.
App scales the 1440 stage. Mock keeps 1440-stage pixels.
Title, count, and 48px slot match on type. Primary button shadow does not.

unimplemented.note: No voice surface in any head. Phase 1 brief also lists voice as out of scope. 1b is a DEVIATION by security rule C6 (DASDEVBOT-LOOK.md:325).

unimplemented.note: #26 has an in-app toast with a Review button. No OS notification.

unimplemented.note: #24 draws Here / Focus / Away. It does not run the return sheet.

unimplemented.surface: Dynamic Island and macOS menu flyout
unimplemented.note: DEVIATION by rule: Windows-only Phase 1 (SCREENS.md:172). The tray numeral on #26 is the remaining live surface and was not frame-matched.
No teammate drag. Shell morph uses ease-out, not --spring-soft.

classified.rule: Security rule C6. Voice never approves. 1b is not a build target. The reply is "Approve on screen."
Security rule C1. Destructive is denied, never asked. 1c still plays a 1200ms voice hold, which the rule removes. #22 and #26 show the flat ink row.
Reduced motion has no transforms. 2a under ?rm still translates on hover and scales the button to 0.97, 0.955. The app rise is a 160ms fade and the press transform is none.
The receipt is 60px. The mock row is min-height 58px. The filed article on main measured 60px, which meets that min-height.
The stamp is HH:MM:SS EDT. The filed mock stamp was "4:31:08 PM". The app stamp was "11:14:07 EDT".
Pens are 1.75. The mock approve stroke computed at 2.33px. The app pen is 1.75px. Line icons on the app are 1.5.
The mascot is Curl. 7a is a character study that includes Curl. The other characters are not a build target.
Windows only. The island and the menu bar in 6a are out. The tray stays.
During the 6s undo the card stays glass. A glass card in that window follows the ruling.
The queue is oldest-first and does not auto-advance. #26 rendered Reviewer 11:14, then the expiring row in place ("expires 1:30"), then Builder 11:52. The header count was 3.
